name: library-branch
note: Sample mode, no state, at the owner's 2000x1200 (below 1440 wide the left dock folds its panel to the rail): the script player's command step runs a row as the palette does (ShellChrome.Run). macro.base.open shows the Library in the left dock with every branch folded; library.branch.toggle with the argument Built-in opens that branch, so the Library lists the shipped tools (before the fix the row threw inside SampleMount and nothing opened); the error lamp counts no failure at any step. The last wait keeps the window open for the foreground check.
